# SILSEP
> SILSEP is an animal nutrition brand of the Censil group, operated by Longyan Shenghe Trading Co., Ltd. (Fujian, China). It engineers feed additives for hot, humid climates: palatability, preservation and bio-efficiency that survive 85°C pelleting and 180-day tropical storage. FAMI-QS (CNBJ380053-CN, site FAM-0673), ISO 22000:2018 (114FSMS2300022) and Halal (SSPY-201318-32223-R3) certified. Serves 30+ countries, focused on Southeast Asia, South Asia and MENA.

## Products
- [Feed Sweetener VS7188 SweetFlow](https://silsep.com/products/feed-sweetener/): carrier-free micro-granular sweetener, 76,000,000 particles/gram, 3-second dissolution, 85°C+ pelleting tolerance.
- [Feed Palatant VS1437 AromaBoost](https://silsep.com/products/feed-palatant/): biomimetic marine attractant profile for fishmeal-replacement formulas; 180-day stability in heat and humidity.
- [LPC Feed Emulsifier](https://silsep.com/products/lpc-emulsifier/): lysophospholipid biosurfactant, HLB 8-12, improves fat digestion and FCR in high-energy feeds.
- [Feed Sweetener VS3965](https://silsep.com/products/feed-sweetener-vs3965/): sucrose-like taste, 60-180 g/T in complete feed, 18-month shelf life.
- [Milk Flavor Palatant VS382](https://silsep.com/products/milk-flavor-vs382/): sweet fresh-milk aroma with MCT/SCFA; trial-proven +13.65% intake in weaned piglets at 600 g/T; 540-day shelf life.
- [Feed Antioxidant VSW5](https://silsep.com/products/feed-antioxidant-vsw5/): synergistic TBHQ+BHT+chelator; complete feed 100-300 g/T up to fishmeal 2,000-3,000 g/T.
